# Workbook fixtures

`ayliinkaya-StudentRegistration.xlsm`: an Excel-made workbook with a UserForm
(`KayitFormu`: text boxes, two combo boxes filled from `VERİ!LABNO` and
`VERİ!SINIFNO`, buttons whose handlers write a row to the `ANASAYFA` sheet,
clear the text boxes through `Me.Controls`, and hide the form). Taken
unchanged from
https://github.com/ayliinkaya/ExcelVBA_userform_StudentRegistration/blob/4c37895a7e8eecfcc39052f891d64b9b4261aaf6/Project_VBA.xlsm
(SHA-256 `80f4aed794e43b01957fc75edf5e3ca0dad561b1658c6469841b057b7d9b138a`),
